title: UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization

entities.name: Control Plane Service Request procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message to initiate services using control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to request control plane services in CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: Control plane service type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of service request (mobile originating/terminating request).

entities.name: ESM message container IE
entities.description: Container for ESM messages like ESM DATA TRANSPORT.

entities.name: NAS message container IE
entities.description: Container for NAS messages like SMS.

entities.name: UE request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE request type (e.g., NAS signalling connection release, Rejection of paging).

entities.name: Paging restriction IE
entities.description: Information element for UE to indicate paging restriction preference.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT
entities.description: ESM message for transporting user data via control plane.

entities.name: T3417
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state entered after sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Mobile terminating request condition
entities.description: Condition where UE sets Control plane service type to mobile terminating request.

entities.name: Mobile originating request condition
entities.description: Condition where UE sets Control plane service type to mobile originating request.

entities.name: Pending user data via control plane condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has pending IP, non-IP or Ethernet user data to send via control plane radio bearers.

entities.name: Pending user data via user plane condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has pending IP, non-IP or Ethernet user data to send via user plane radio bearers.

entities.name: SMS sending condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is sending SMS via CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection release condition
entities.description: Condition where UE requests NAS signalling connection release.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

Message may contain NAS message container IE.

Message may contain Paging restriction IE.
ESM message container may contain ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.
Control plane service type IE is set to mobile terminating request under specific conditions.
Control plane service type IE is set to mobile originating request under specific conditions.

Condition establishes setting of Control plane service type IE with active flag.
Condition establishes inclusion of NAS message container IE for SMS.
